request.caption: Cinematic chamber folk ballad blended with slow-burn indie rock. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar and warm cello, a steady piano ostinato, soft brushed drums and a slow deep kick that move with the vocal at the same slow tempo, no fast breakbeats. The verses stay sparse and intimate with guitar, cello and piano; in every chorus the drums, strings and electric guitar swell in layer by layer; the bridge drops back to guitar and voice; the final chorus is the widest and fullest; the outro returns to the fingerpicked guitar alone. Warm close-miked female lead vocal, unhurried phrasing, every word sung clearly, clear English diction. Wooden, earthy, tender, quietly strong, cinematic
